children: GEN Restaurant Group reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $48.7 million, down 3.3% year over year, and a net loss of $5.5 million. The company recorded a $6.0 million operating loss and a $0.6 million adjusted EBITDA loss. GEN also reported $4.7 million in CPG revenue and outlined plans to sell the operations of 47 restaurants to Chubby Group while retaining its brand and CPG business.
Revenue was $48.7 million, compared with $50.4 million in the third quarter of 2025. Restaurant revenue was $44.0 million, down 12.7% year over year.
Loss from operations was $6.0 million, compared with a $3.7 million loss in the prior-year quarter.
Net loss was $5.5 million, or $0.16 per basic and diluted share of Class A common stock, compared with a $3.6 million net loss, or $0.11 per share, a year earlier.
Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, was a loss of $0.6 million, compared with a loss of $0.2 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Cash and cash equivalents totaled $2.9 million at September 30, 2026, and total debt outstanding was $26.8 million.

GEN signed a binding letter of intent with Chubby Group for the sale of operations at 47 U.S. restaurants in a transaction valued at up to $100 million; the parties are negotiating definitive agreements.

Under the proposed arrangement, the restaurants would transition in four phases over 12 months. GEN would retain the GEN brand, its CPG business and its Cerritos restaurant, which will support training, staffing and CPG research and development.

GEN products expanded to more than 2,000 retail doors, including Bristol Farms, Vallarta Supermarkets and Olé City Market. The company also entered university dining and live-entertainment venues through UCLA Dining and SoFi Stadium.
Additional retail placements are scheduled to begin reaching shelves in the second quarter of 2027.

GEN began reducing corporate overhead and said it plans to restructure its organization as restaurant operations transfer, with Chubby expected to continue employing team members at the restaurants it acquires.
